pr_title: Adding remote config/logging capabilities to Windows build
pr_body:
Enabled remote config and logging capabilities using TLS. 

For remote TLS logging and/or filesystem logging to work correctly, a glog with a bug fix (https://github.com/google/glog/pull/123).

Closes #2425 
Closes #2426

issue_context.title: Windows: enable remote and TLS plugins in CMake
comments: The AWS-based plugins will need help after remote is building. (AWS-SDK-based plugins are out of scope).
